name: glyph-tide
description: Code glyphs that water ripples reveal behind the desktop and mobile conversation

motion.title: Waves
motion.description: Animate the waves. Off, the glyphs stay still. A system that reduces motion stills them too

wavesPerMinute.title: Waves per minute
wavesPerMinute.description: How often a wave starts. A wave spreads at the same speed at any value

hideAfterPrompt.title: Hide after the first prompt
hideAfterPrompt.description: Remove the backdrop when the session gets its first prompt
